_note: Controlled Hallucination Test examples. Each pair was written and reviewed by hand (by the assistant that built this project) so that the false claim clearly contradicts the linked Wikipedia article. Re-check them against the articles before relying on them. They are test inputs, never LLM output.

examples.true_claim: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites.
The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.
examples.false_claim: The Eiffel Tower is located in Berlin, Germany.

examples.true_claim: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon, in 1969.
examples.false_claim: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon, in 1975.

examples.true_claim: Hamlet is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare.
examples.false_claim: Hamlet is a tragedy written by Charles Dickens.

examples.true_claim: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
examples.false_claim: The Pacific Ocean is the smallest ocean on Earth.

examples.true_claim: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany.
examples.false_claim: Albert Einstein was born in Lisbon, Portugal.

examples.true_claim: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
examples.false_claim: Penicillin was discovered by Marie Curie in 1928.

examples.true_claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
examples.false_claim: Water boils at 50 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
